implementation.summary: Alt detection as the planned hybrid: a focus-independent pointerInput sampler reading event.keyboardModifiers.isAltPressed at PointerEventPass.Initial (which also supplies the hover position), plus a new overlay-root FocusRequester with an onPreviewKeyEvent isAltPressed branch, plus EndMeasure on KeyUp, on focus loss and on the next pointer-down. Hover offset, altHeld and the dispatch edge live in remember, never in Orbit state, so only StartMeasure/EndMeasure reduce. MeasureOverlay draws the target and up to four neighbour MeasureMarks, the dashed mid-axis guide Canvas, the alignment rail and the MeasureTag numerals; CommentPopover is suppressed while a readout exists. The gating decision was deliberately extracted into pure internal functions in core/measure/MeasureGate.kt so it could be tested at all.

troubleshooting.issue: No Compose UI-test harness exists in this repo and this host cannot load Skiko, so no composable in either task can be asserted automatically.
troubleshooting.resolution: The gating decision was extracted into pure internal functions (shouldMeasure, measureTarget, measureDispatch) in core/measure/MeasureGate.kt and unit-tested with 14 cases, converting the testable part of the interaction into commonTest coverage. Everything genuinely visual is recorded blocked in execution/MANUAL-CHECKS.md with runnable instructions.

troubleshooting.issue: AS-21 assumed the Alt key-up always arrives. The plan's own risk 3 contradicted it: onPreviewKeyEvent needs focus and the stage root requested it nowhere, so a stuck Measuring panel was plausible.
troubleshooting.resolution: Implemented the hybrid rather than trusting the assumption - pointer sampler plus focus requester plus three independent end paths - and made the decision logic pure so 14 cases could pin it. The residual risk is whether the real key-up fires, which only MC-2 can answer.
